integrity: The finite theorem is proved by conditioning a single occupancy cell and reducing Pearson chi-square to pair collisions. The variance and asymptotic formulas are independently reconstructed from pair-indicator and multinomial occupancy moments; exact enumeration is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The exact one-polynomial covariance formula assumes equal multinomial cell probabilities.
The fixed-load correlation limit keeps the occupancy level r fixed.
An equivalent mixed-moment identity may exist in older occupancy or goodness-of-fit literature under different notation.
title: Exact occupancy-spectrum covariance profile for Pearson's chi-square
